From the kitchen

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A neon sign in Larnaca

Salamis sits on Fikardo Garcia Lorka street in Larnaca, under a neon sign with two palm trees that reads Restaurant Salamis Steak House, fresh fish, ψαροταβέρνα, cocktail bar, sports bar. In the restaurant’s own words: traditional fish meze and Cypriot and international cuisine, Cypriot hospitality, fresh seafood. On Google, guests mention the portions, the fresh seafood and the local dishes most often; the fish meze and the fish soup are the most popular orders.

Open every day: Monday to Saturday from half past eleven in the morning until half past eleven at night, Sunday from eleven to eleven. Delivery as well.

What guests say

Two of 672 Google reviews, 4.5 stars on average.

“Wonderful place to relax. Huge portions, almost impossible to finish. Very fresh salads. Tender shrimp. And the owner is wonderful with his guests. He greets you personally and helps you choose dishes to suit your tastes. I'm so glad I found Salamis. Thank you so much!”
M T · Google review
“In an area full of fancy restaurants, Salamis was the one that stood out the most for us. The food is amazing, the service was so friendly and the prices are fair (very big portions). The grilled octopus was incredible, and the affelia is also a local must try (marinated pork meat)!”
Pat Broilo · Google review
